register.description: After a meeting with representatives from Suncorp discussing disaster management, response scenarios and threat modelling I was their guest for an interesting meal at Callao Barangaroo, where we enjoyed reimagined traditional dishes with a Nikkei twist and Japanese precision met Peruvian vibrancy – Cost unknown

Since 2020 Woolworths has raised $2.8 million dollars for WIRES to help support the rescue and care of Australian wildlife affected by fire, drought and flood, and this Christmas they are expecting to increase that by $500,000 through the sale of limited edition Wally the Wombat chocolate loaf cakes, where $1 will be donated directly to WIRES for every Wally sold. Jaimie Lovell from the Woolworths group very kindly just gifted to my office our very own delicious 620g Wally the Wombat chocolate loaf cake along with his best wishes for Christmas and the new year. I have no idea if it was as delicious as they say because it had all been consumed by the time I went to have some!! (looking at you Adz) – Value $25
